title: Kamishiro Rui — Fantastic Planner〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Event: An Ode for the Pure of Heart

rows.Line: Wedding Ceremony Hall

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Okay, that should be it for our final checks...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Yay! I'm glad we made it in time for the actual wedding!>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: All that's left for us is to wait for it to start.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Yeah! I hope everything goes well!>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, so do I.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (The proposal scene and the dance after that should be all set to go too...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Everybody here wants our performance and this ceremony to succeed.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I'm sure it'll go well...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (No, I need to keep doing what I can to guarantee success. One last check...)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Um, Rui...?>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hm? Yes?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Uh... Are you getting nervous, maybe?>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Me? Nervous?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, I see. I may be getting a little nervous...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It's been quite a while since I last did a show with people outside of Wonderlands×Showtime.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Maybe not since that one time...)

What the... I'm not doing something that dumb.
Don't you have any better ideas?
Are you having a laugh trying to get us hurt?
I've had enough of you and your stupid shows.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I was under the impression that nobody else would understand what I was hoping to achieve and had to do it all myself...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: At least, that was what I thought back then.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But I have Tsukasa and the others now.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: They're willing to go along with my ideas as long as we can make our audiences smile and laugh.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That's why I've been able to put on the shows that I've been truly wanting to. It's all thanks to them.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But when I'm working with complete strangers...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <You were worried about what would happen. You weren't sure if they would accept your ideas...>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes. That may've caused me to hesitate somewhat.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: However, I wasn't the only one doing something they're not used to doing.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: In particular, Aoyagi, since he said it was the first time he's had to sing while acting at the same time.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: He definitely seemed like more of the quiet type and not one to talk to people he doesn't really know.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yet he was willing to talk to me and the other objectors for the sake of this ceremony.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Someone in my family thinks in sort of the same way.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I didn't understand what he was doing at first. It puzzled me how he could torment a family member over such a thing.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But now I understand a little.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I believe that Akito decided to help us because he came to an understanding that your way would work in this case.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: There are certain things that we aren't willing to compromise on as well...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: He likely felt some weight in terms of having to replace Tsukasa...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But his modesty and hard-working honesty have been invaluable.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'm glad he's here today.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We should head back now. We'll need to keep making sure everything is ready as time permits.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<Hey, Rui, wait...!
Look, it's them.>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Honestly, I just can't figure out what Kamishiro's thinking...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But I do know that he's serious about making all these people happy with his show.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I feel like I'm being played by him...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But I said I'll help, so I'm giving it everything I've got. No ifs, ands or buts...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <That's great, Rui!>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, thank you.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I'm glad they're both here today.)
